services.name: llama-cpp-5090
services.note: RTX 5090 (fixed card); router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/5090; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: llama-cpp-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti (fixed card); router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/4070ti; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: llama-cpp-both
services.note: RTX 5090 + RTX 4070 Ti layer split (5090 main); exclusive: starting it stops every other GPU service incl. strata, and any GPU start stops it; router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/both; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: strata-5090
services.note: RTX 5090; one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: strata-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti; one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: strata-both
services.note: RTX 5090 + RTX 4070 Ti (layer split); one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: rizzo
services.note: Rizzo Flow local Jev-compatible System One decisions (POST /v1/systemone); llama.cpp CUDA on 4070 Ti; built from containers/rizzo-flow/

services.name: comfyui-5090
services.note: RTX 5090; runs on the card strata is not on (scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves it); one variant at a time, same port + container name

services.name: comfyui-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti; runs on the card strata is not on (scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves it); one variant at a time, same port + container name

services.name: sketchlab
services.note: same-origin /v1 AI proxy -> strata (key injected by nginx from config/sketchlab/service.env); proxy shares sketchlab's LAN exposure

services.name: hyperframes
services.note: built locally from ~/workspace/github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes at upstream commit f70dce7

services.name: hermes
services.note: opt-in (install.sh --with-hermes); this host runs Hermes natively (hermes-gateway.service), so the container is not deployed by default
